text_block_list.text:
I've got to do something about Fusaichi 
Pandora.

Internal issues aren't something that can 
be dealt with right away, so taking the 
long-term view...

"In any case, for now we must get her into 
the groove and train her harder than ever 
before—"
I wanted to get things started, but...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: No way!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"C'mon! You make it sound so easy, telling 
me to run fast enough to blow past 
everyone ahead of me, but—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: That's awful!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: No way!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna go to the gym! I want the 
pool today~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Because the gym was so boring the other 
day~. The routine was way too long, and I 
got super sore afterwards."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Instead of the gym, let's play that game 
in the pool~ You know, the one where we 
look for sparkly gems~
choice_data_list:
If you work hard at the gym, let's go buy 
donuts!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ugh...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I still don't wanna~!

In defiance of my strict training, she 
started refusing more often, telling me 
flat out, "No way."

Could it be that she's experiencing some 
sort of psychological shift unique to the 
still-mysterious nature of Umamusume?

—Fretting over it won't help. I decided to 
consult a doctor who specialized in 
Umamusume physiology and psychology.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, Umamusume undergo a phase 
distinct from regular humans. For 
instance—the "Bloom."

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
“It refers to the growth period of an 
Umamusume as an athlete, during which her 
racing abilities develop dramatically.”

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
And... Pandora-san's current behavior gave 
me the impression of being similar to a 
toddler's "terrible twos" phase.

Is this around the time when an 
Umamusume's 'terrible twos' phase kicks 
in...!?

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
No, I've never heard of that before. I 
wonder what it could be... Sounds rough.

At any rate, there didn't seem to be a 
clear reason. In that case, the only way 
to solve it was trial and error. And so—

Devising gamified workouts, securing 
scenic training locations, and more.

I went through trial and error, like 
bringing her the limited-to-10-servings 
pudding she might like as a reward—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Nooooo waaaaay--!!

The days of suffering complete defeat 
continued...
choice_data_list: (What in the world should I do...?!)

text_block_list.text: Then, one day.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Pandora, you're here today too!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Look, it's Kuu-chan-senpai! Aww, yay♡

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. I'm really happy Pandora-san is 
here too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, oops, sorry for interrupting you! See 
you later, then!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Phew, first, let's give it all we've got!
(Dadadadada!!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh, whoaa~! Full throttle right from the 
get-go...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh? Kuu-chan-senpai did it again—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huff, puff...! Nnnngh!! No more, this is 
too tough...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Still!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: It starts here!! Grrrrrr~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: A-Amaze...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: *gasp*, *pant*, *wheeze*, *pant*!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my legs... are so completely pumped 
full of lactic acid! I can't... anymore—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ~~gh, I can... still go! One more set!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Taaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
“...... I don't really get why, but I 
ended up following you. Still—”

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Kuu-chan-senpai. You said it was 
impossible, but you didn't slow down at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Keep running, further and further— ...Why?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "Why?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, honestly? Once you're tired, 
doesn't it make you just wanna quit?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if you push yourself till you 
collapse, you wouldn't wanna get back up, 
right? You'd totally feel like, 'Ugh, why 
even bother getting up?', right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I don't get it. I didn't get 
it at all! Kuu-chan-senpai is already so 
strong, and yet—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Why do that much?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
When my legs feel heavy and it hurts, even 
I sometimes think, 'Maybe that's enough.'

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Still, I guess the reason I find myself 
taking that extra step... is because of my 
admiration for them after all.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: For the sake of... my dream...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's an aspiration to become the kind of 
Umamusume whose hoofprints will endure 
into the distant future.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Knowing it's to make that dream come true 
gives me the strength to take that step, 
no matter how heavy my legs feel."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: What's that, so cool~!

To deal with Fusaichi Pandora's stubborn 
"No way!", I bought tons of rewards, 
stayed up all night planning tactics, and 
faced the next day's training—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
What's on the menu? I'm totally gonna 
crush it all♡
choice_data_list: Huh!? W-Why all of a sudden—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It's not that, it's just that 
Ku-chan-senpai was saying all this intense 
stuff and it was so cool.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: That's it.

Just what did Rhein Kraft say? I was a bit 
curious, but—

At any rate, if you've overcome that 
'terrible twos' phase, we should be happy 
for now!

And so, from that day on, we were able to 
conduct training somewhat more smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew, whew. Totally gave it my all 
today, right?! I'm gonna treat myself to 
my special face pack!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(...Trainer looked so happy. Guess they 
really were worried after all?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...I mean, isn't my Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Trainer's special 'Ultra Nutritious 
Okonomiyaki'?! Ooh~ not bad, looks delish!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're gonna eat it, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
We're out of ingredients. Well, I'm fine 
though!

We're out of materials, so... Well, I'm 
fine anyway!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehhー! Really!? No way, thank you♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, those new kicks— Aren't those my 
shoes?!
choice_data_list:
I thought it might help with your races, 
Pandora, so I just couldn't resist!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you supposed to buy your own 
shoes?!
choice_data_list:
Ah! ...No, it's fine. We can do mine next 
time!

Ah! ...No, it's fine. We can do mine next 
time!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(...In the end, I'm still wearing these 
tattered shoes myself!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Even today—)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa! Ugh, seriously, how many 
kilometers are left!? This is awful~!
choice_data_list:
You can do it! Come on... I'll run with 
you!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No, you're a human— Wait, whoa, don't get 
off your bike! Seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft. Haha, ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(This feeling... sort of reminds me of 
someone...)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(I don't know... doing so much for me, 
being so kind...)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...It's warm... that feeling... I know 
it—"
